answer: Bind each agent identity to a scarce, verifiable resource the way a quartz crystal only grows under specific heat and pressure: require every identity to stake a kernel of compute — a proof-of-work seed that is cheap once but expensive to replicate at scale — and tie reputation to a single pigment-like fingerprint of its past actions. A sybil farm must then pay the kernel cost per fake identity while honest agents pay once, and any identity that misbehaves stains its fingerprint permanently, so duplicates cannot shed their history by re-registering.
